main_issue: How to get Agent D's unfinished section (and the pitch) done by Thursday given D's bereavement, with B and C refusing extra work and A pushing for a solution.

A-B.evidence: B rejects extra work (T4, T9, T13, T23); A pressures B (T8) and demands B justify their situation (T24); A's review request is refused.

A-C.evidence: C refuses to take or review D's section (T7, T14, T16); A demands a solution from both (T22) and C does not yield.

A-D.evidence: A forbids D from working (T18, T20) while D offers to work late on the section (T17, T19); D gives a passive 'Okay. I understand' (T21) but never drops the idea.

B-C.evidence: C: 'I'm with Agent B' (T14); both refuse extra work and review.

B-D.evidence: D offers to do own section (T17) while B refuses extra work (T4, T9); they never address each other, though B's position isn't opposed to D's offer.

C-D.evidence: C declines to cover D's section (T7); D's offer to work on it herself (T17, T19) is compatible but they never address each other.
